scoring_justification: Checker extracts numeric values from text files and compares to paper-reported reference within tolerance; the values are deterministic outputs of the computational protocol.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for formation energy and barriers
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I and text: formation energy 3.36 eV (LDA, 215-atom, 2³ k-points), migration barrier 0.40 eV, reorientation barrier 0.20 eV
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper's reported values (section III, IV).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly from the paper's reported results for the same computational conditions.

schema.description: Single line: E_form = <value> eV. The value is a real number (eV units).

outputs.description: Vacancy formation energy computed from DFT total energies.

schema.description: Single line: E_barrier_hop = <value> eV. The value is a real number (eV units).

outputs.description: Lowest migration energy barrier for nearest‑neighbour vacancy hopping.

schema.description: Single line: E_barrier_reorient = <value> eV. The value is a real number (eV units).

outputs.description: Energy barrier for reorientation between equivalent D₂d states.

output_contract.notes: These three numbers are the main reproducible quantities of the study. The hidden checker compares each to the paper‑reported value within a tolerance.
